The observed batch-20 source asserts that translation out sends a wall Verma to a direct sum of the two regular Vermas. For sl_2, T_{-1}^{0}M(-1)=L(1) tensor M(-1); both flag factors are in the principal block. In weight -2, e maps each of the two tensor basis vectors to opposite nonzero multiples of the highest vector, so the singular space is one-dimensional; M(0) direct sum M(-2) has two singular vectors in that weight. Hence the direct-sum assertion is false. With the declared external shift M(d)_j=M_{j+d}, a degree-two free generator contributes (-2), and the correct left-module decomposition is C(1) direct sum C(-1), not C(1) direct sum C(3). The old proof also deduces a C-linear natural isomorphism from rank-two vector-space counts without identifying the translated endomorphism action. Close the argument with standard flags, the correct shifts, the endomorphism-ring inclusion and the descended restriction/extension adjunction (Soergel Section 2.4, Theorem 10 and its proof).
